    kernel_w: T.int32,
    stride_h: T.int32,
    stride_w: T.int32,
    pad_h: T.int32,
    pad_w: T.int32,
):

    A_buf = T.match_buffer(A, [batch_size, in_channels, height, width], dtype="float16")
    B_buf = T.match_buffer(B, [out_channels, in_channels, kernel_h, kernel_w], dtype="float16")

        T.writes(C_buf[0:batch_size, 0:out_channels, 0:(height + 2 * pad_h - kernel_h) // stride_h + 1, 0:(width + 2 * pad_w - kernel_w) // stride_w + 1])

                            T.axis.spatial((width + 2 * pad_w - kernel_w) // stride_w + 1, ow)
                            
                            # Initialize accumulator with zero
                            sum = T.alloc_buffer([1], dtype="float32")
                            sum[0] = 0.0

                                        # Check bounds

                            # Store result
                            C_buf[b, oc, oh, ow] = T.cast(sum[0], "float16")
